sources.entry: Pixpresso - Image viewer and editor for cropping, resizing, annotating, and converting between PNG, JPG, WebP, and HEIC. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Pixpresso
summary.one_liner: Pixpresso is a free image viewer and editor for cropping, resizing, rotating, annotating, filtering and exporting screenshots and photos, with on-device text copying from images.
use_cases: Pulling text out of screenshots or photos
Marking up images for bug or design feedback
Shrinking photos before sharing by email or web
Triaging photo folders with arrow keys
summary.what_it_does:
Pixpresso opens an image and shows the other images from the same folder in a sidebar, navigable with the arrow keys. Its modes cover View, Crop (free or locked aspect ratios), Resize with a live output size, Rotate and Flip, and Annotate with shapes, text, emoji stickers, and logo watermarks with opacity. Filters include brightness, contrast, saturation, blur and nine presets with intensity sliders. Changes are saved back to the file or exported as JPEG, PNG, WebP or TIFF, and Reset reverts to the state before the first save in the session.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Copy text from images, with text recognition done on the user's computer
Folder sidebar for browsing and triaging images with keyboard navigation
Save over the original or export a copy, with revert to pre-save state
Supports HEIC and HEIF on macOS
caveats: HEIC and HEIF opening is limited to macOS
Exports are limited to JPEG, PNG, WebP and TIFF
